title: A circuit document, as the engine answers it (Circuit)

Analysis.description: How a circuit is run: transient, and for how long, in seconds.

group.description: the group's name; empty when it is in none

default.description: Whether there is nothing to write: in no group, free.

Arrangement.description: How a drawn item stands among the others: the group it is chosen and moved with — empty for none —, and its own state. An item is held where it stands when it is locked itself or its group is (holds).

name.description: a bench shared by name — i2c-bus —, or null

duration.description: seconds it runs, or null where its expectation's measure says

temperature.description: the temperature it runs at, kelvin, or null for the nominal bench

realistic.description: whether its instruments load what they read and a part fails as its component says

parts.description: the parts it adds round the part tried: sources, loads, instruments

Bench.description: What a part is tried among: a bench's parts, how long it runs, at what temperature, and whether it is realistic — its instruments load what they read, a part fails as its component says.

name.description: what it is called — D, I2C —, unique among the circuit's buses

index.description: a vector's numbers, [0..7]; null for a group

members.description: its nets, in order: a vector's from its index, a group's as written

Bus.description: A bus of a circuit: a named set of its nets, drawn as one thick line and handed across a sheet's edge as one port. It joins nothing by itself — a part's pin is on a member by naming the member's net —; it says which nets travel together. a vector, bus(D[0..7]): its nets are the language's indexed names of it, D_0 … D_7; a group, bus(I2C, members: [SDA, SCL]): the nets it names, in their order.

pin.description: the pin it names; null when the part is connected in pin order

net.description: the net the pin is on

Connection.description: One connection of a part: the pin it names — none when the part is connected in pin order — and the net.

value.description: the value — or the row of values — the measure must be
the value the measure is held near

tolerance.description: how far from it the measure may be: 5%, 2 mV

anyOf.description: the values the measure may take
the values the measure may take

slug.description: what the document is known by: its address among the library's

title.description: what it is called, for a reader

type.description: the role its kind gives it — type gate —, or null where it says none

meta.description: its meta fields — summary, source, category … —, as written

DocumentHead.description: What every document of the model says of itself: its slug, its title, the role its kind gives it (type gate), and its meta fields — summary, source, category… — as written.

DrawnGroup.description: A group of a drawing as an item of its own: its name, by which its members say they are in it, and its state — a locked group holds every member where it stands, whatever each says of itself.

title.description: what it says holds, for a reader

source.description: why it holds — a datasheet's line, a calculation —, or empty

bench.description: the bench it runs on when it is not the document's own, or null

anyOf.description: what the measure is held to
what the measure is held to
what the measure is held to

Expectation.description: What a document says it does, to be checked by running it: what holds, why — its source —, on which bench, measured how, held to what.

written.description: the expression as its author wrote it

Formula.description: An expression as its author wrote it — 4.7 kΩ, 100 * abs(anode.current) / I_maximum —, for jMF to compile where it is computed. The model says what it is for; what it means is the formula language's.

Index.description: The index a name is written with: a bus's bits — q[0..7] —, or a row's slots — memory[256], slots 0 to 255. Each of them is a name of its own, the name and its number joined: q_0, memory_255.

statistic.description: what is taken of the reading: final, maximum, average, frequency …

subject.description: the net or expression it reads, or null where it reads something else

reading.description: what else it reads — current, level, levels, figure, figures —, or null for a subject

targets.description: what that reading names: a part, a net, a part's figures

conditions.description: each condition's word and its value in SI: after, above, below, at

settings.description: the settings changed for this measure alone

Measure.description: What an expectation measures: a statistic — final, maximum, average, frequency… — of a subject — a net, current R1, out - in —, and when: after 60 ms, above 2.5 V, at 1 kHz, with settings changed for it.

name.description: what it is called, as formulas name it

anyOf.description: its value: a formula, or a text
its value: a formula, or a text
the values it may take, or null for any
the values it may take, or null for any

step.description: how far one step of a control moves it, or null

per.description: the unit it is counted per — V per unit —, or null

flags.description: how it is offered, as written: log, integer, exact, animate, live

description.description: what it is, for a reader; empty when not written

Parameter.description: A parameter of a component or a circuit: its name, its value, and what a reader may set it to — a range, a step, a unit it is counted per, and how it is offered (log, integer, live…).

reference.description: what the circuit calls it — R1 —, unique in the circuit

component.description: the component it is, by slug — resistor, lm358@3 for a unit of one

connections.description: what each of its pins is connected to, in pin order or by pin

settings.description: what its parameters are set to

symbol.description: the symbol it is drawn with when not its component's own, or null

footprint.description: the footprint it sits on when not its component's own, or null

pads.description: which pin each pad of that footprint takes, by pad, where this part's differ from what its component says: a footprint another product numbers its own way — a KiCad diode's pad 1 is its cathode. Empty otherwise.

Part.description: A part of a circuit: its reference, the component it is — resistor, lm358@3 for a unit of one —, what it is connected to, what it is set to, and how it is drawn or seated when not as its component says. ⚠️ Every part is a component. A resistor and a microcontroller are the same kind of thing here; which of them the engine solves natively is the engine's to say, from the component, never a second sort of part.

reference.description: the name the line is known by — B1 —, unique on the sheet

bus.description: the bus it draws, by name

arrangement.description: the group it is chosen and moved with, and whether it is locked where it stands

Placement.BusLine.description: A line of a bus: the thick line it is drawn as on the sheet. It names one of the circuit's buses, which says what it carries; a sheet may draw one bus as several lines. It joins nothing by itself — an entry on it is a mark of a member's net.

reference.description: the name its line is known by — R1, wire-3 —, unique on the sheet

via.description: its points: a line's corners, a rectangle's two opposite corners, a circle's centre and a point on it, an arc's two ends and a point it goes through

arrangement.description: the group it is chosen and moved with, and whether it is locked where it stands

Placement.Drawn.description: A line or a shape drawn on a sheet for whoever reads it: it joins nothing.

reference.description: the name its line is known by — R1, wire-3 —, unique on the sheet

symbol.description: what it is — junction, ground, label… —, as written

net.description: the net it names — label vp, ground agnd —, or null

rotation.description: how far it is turned, degrees

arrangement.description: the group it is chosen and moved with, and whether it is locked where it stands

Placement.Mark.description: A mark that is no part: a junction, a ground, a common, a label, a power flag.

reference.description: the name its line is known by — R1, wire-3 —, unique on the sheet

arrangement.description: the group it is chosen and moved with, and whether it is locked where it stands

Placement.Note.description: Words written on a sheet for whoever reads it: they join nothing.

reference.description: the part it places, as the circuit names it

unit.description: the block placed on its own, B; null for the part as a whole

rotation.description: how far it is turned, degrees

name.description: where its reference is written, from its centre, or null where the sheet puts it

value.description: where its value is written, from its centre, or null

readings.description: where an instrument's readings are written, from its centre, or null

size.description: a placed sheet's box, as KiCad sizes a hierarchical sheet, or null for a part drawn by its symbol

shows.description: what an instrument's display shows — rms, graph —, as written

ports.description: where a placed sheet's ports stand on its frame, as written; a port it does not place stands where the sheet puts it

arrangement.description: the group it is chosen and moved with, and whether it is locked where it stands

Placement.PlacedPart.description: A part where it stands — or one block of it, placed on its own: U4.B at ….

port.description: the port, by its net on the sheet placed

edge.description: the frame's edge it stands on

along.description: how far from the edge's start, in the sheet's units

Placement.PortPlace.description: Where a port of a placed sheet stands on the sheet's frame — in left 60 —: the edge, and how far along it from its start, the top of a side edge and the left of the top and bottom ones. KiCad draws a hierarchical sheet's pins wherever its author put them, and a wire drawn to one comes back to the same point only if the port does.

reference.description: the name its line is known by — R1, wire-3 —, unique on the sheet

from.description: where it starts, as its line writes it: a part's pin — R1.negative — or a mark, by its reference

to.description: where it ends, written as from is

via.description: its corners between its ends, in order

arrangement.description: the group it is chosen and moved with, and whether it is locked where it stands

Placement.Wire.description: A wire from one pin to another — R1.negative —, through its corners.

Point.description: A place on a sheet or a pcb, in its units.

channel.description: the channel's name on the oscilloscope: A, B …

subject.description: what it reads: a net, or the part whose current it reads

reference.description: the second net of a voltage, or null for ground

scale.description: a division's worth — 2 V/div —, or null where the bench chooses

shows.description: what the screen shows, X being the reading, or null for the reading itself

Probe.description: A channel of a bench's oscilloscope: what it reads — a net's voltage, a part's current, a logic level —, against which net, at what scale, and what its screen shows of the reading.

Range.Between.description: low .. high: every value from one end to the other.

Range.Listed.description: The list as written, brackets and all, for jMF to read.

name.description: the parameter it sets, or the word that stands alone

anyOf.description: what it is set to: a formula, or a text
what it is set to: a formula, or a text

Setting.description: A name a part is set by — resistance = R, bytes = "8 0" —, or one standing alone, closed.

ports.description: the nets it hands to the block that places it, each a pin of that block

nets.description: the nets named for what they are beyond the sheet

empty.description: Whether it hands nothing across: a circuit that is no sheet of another.

SheetBoundary.description: What a circuit hands across its sheet's edge when it is placed as a block in another: its ports — each a net and which way it goes, input in —, and the nets it shares with every sheet of its project by name, vcc global.

ground.description: whether it is the ground everything is measured from

global.description: whether every sheet of the project shares it by its name

SheetBoundary.Net.description: A net named for what it is beyond the sheet.

direction.description: input, output, power, ground or analog

SheetBoundary.Port.description: A net the sheet hands to its parent, a pin of the block that places it.

text.description: what it says, without its quotes

Text.description: A text a name is given — operation = "write" —: what it says, without its quotes.

primary.description: whether it is the view the circuit is first shown in

parameter.description: the parameter it sweeps, or null

from.description: where the sweep starts, or null

to.description: where the sweep ends, or null

points.description: how many points the sweep is taken at, or null

View.description: A view a circuit is shown in — transient_response, frequency_response from 1 to 100000 points 200, a sweep of one of its parameters.

head.description: what the document says of itself: its slug, its title, its role and its meta fields

parameters.description: its parameters, which its parts' settings may name

parts.description: its parts, each between named nets

layout.description: where each part, wire, mark, note and drawing stands on its sheet

probes.description: the channels the bench's oscilloscope reads

timeBase.description: the oscilloscope's time a division — time 5 ms/div —, or null

expectations.description: what it says it does, to be checked by running it

analysis.description: how it is run, or null where whoever runs it says

views.description: the views it is shown in: a run in time, a sweep

frame.description: the frame its sheet stands in, by slug — frame iso-a4-landscape-frame —, or null

boundary.description: what it hands across its sheet's edge when it is placed as a block

buses.description: its buses: the named sets of its nets that travel together, drawn by its bus lines

groups.description: the groups its layout's items are chosen and moved with, each with its own state

description: A circuit: its parameters, its parts between named nets — net GROUND the reference —, where they are drawn, what the bench probes, what it is expected to show, and how it is run.
